prd_sections.title: Overview and Scope
prd_sections.summary: Defines channels, threads, dialog messages, and content linkage for structured discussions.

prd_sections.title: Directory and Thread Model
prd_sections.summary: Specifies federation-node and channel-key filesystem layout with thread manifests and typed folders.

prd_sections.title: Data Model and Tables
prd_sections.summary: Defines lupo_channels, lupo_dialog_threads, lupo_dialog_messages, and supporting channel state tables.

prd_sections.title: Identity and Routing
prd_sections.summary: Enforces actor-based attribution and deterministic routing through channel_id and dialog_thread_id.

prd_sections.title: Constitutional Constraints
prd_sections.summary: Requires BIGINT UTC, no foreign keys, no triggers, explicit IDs, and soft-delete conventions.

prd_rules.summary: Filesystem channel threads must follow federation_node_id/channel_key/thread_key structure.
Primary keys must be dialog_thread_id and dialog_message_id, never generic id.
Message attribution must resolve to actor identity; from_actor_id request mapping is API to DB actor_id.
Discussion rows must use is_deleted and deleted_ymdhis instead of hard deletes.
No foreign keys, no triggers, and no database-side automation in channels namespace.
